description: Bounded interpretation of retained CIL with source-bound collection/value stubs and injected geometry sinks
sinks: INw2 returns per-widget supplied rectangles; no numeric resize formula tested
Panel get_AllPinnedObjects supplied list; its source filter is documented separately
VbN8 and YJ0S ordinary branch instructions are interpreted; final Size/Location setters are captured, notifications/history are not executed
TrapScaling cleanup modeled from its retained closure; enumerator Dispose is inert
SizingRect/rotated AABB/UnroundedRect/effective pin style/capabilities are explicit inputs; rectangle numeric solver is not run
